answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment. An attacker must incur a positive cost delta to acquire sufficient voting power, effectively creating a financial knoll that shields the protocol from malicious actors. By requiring bonded collateral, the network serves as a secure haven for decentralized agents, where the barrier to entry is tethered to verifiable resource ownership rather than the easily replicated identities of fictitious nodes.
